task: Match SDPA numerically (state a tolerance); add causal + GQA + non-power-of-2 head-dim edge cases; sweep seq lengths and ncu-attribute the gap to FA2.

title: Build: FlashAttention backward pass
task: Implement + gradcheck the backward kernel — dQ/dK/dV with recompute and the rowsum(dO*O) delta trick; the dK/dV accumulation is the hard part most reimplementations skip.

title: Ship: flash-attention-triton (+ torch.compile contrast)

title: Build: DDP from scratch
task: DDP from scratch — gradient bucketing + all-reduce/backward overlap; parity vs torch DDP on 2 GPUs, and prove the overlap with nsys.

title: Build: ZeRO-1 optimizer-state partitioning
task: ZeRO-1 on top of your DDP; measure the memory savings and reconcile against the paper's accounting.

title: Build: tensor parallelism (Megatron)
task: TP for an MLP + attention block (column-parallel → row-parallel with all-reduce; the f/g conjugate operators); verify parity vs single-GPU.

title: Build: 1F1B pipeline parallelism
task: 1F1B pipeline across 2 stages; measure and explain the bubble; sketch how DP+TP+PP compose into 3D.

title: Recomputation + mixed precision + overlap
task: Add gradient checkpointing + bf16 (fp32 master weights, loss scaling); measure the memory/throughput tradeoff. (Connects to the rematerialization thread from D1.)

links.label: llm.c — raw C/CUDA implementation to read

title: MoE & expert parallelism (survey)
task: Toy top-2 MoE layer with all-to-all dispatch + an aux load-balancing loss. 1-day breadth pass — don't rabbit-hole.

title: Sequence parallelism + checkpoint/restore
task: Checkpoint save/restore + simulated failure recovery; verify resumed training matches the loss curve. Note how sequence/context parallelism extends attention across devices.

title: Integrate: train a small GPT in parallel (8×H100)
task: Combine DDP+TP+ckpt+bf16 into one framework (finish CS336 A2's distributed part); train a small GPT on 8×H100, measure MFU + a scaling curve. Debug on 1 GPU first. (US holiday — shift to Jul 6 if taking it off.)

title: Ship: mini-distributed-training (scaling study)
task: Ship the repo: scaling study with MFU decomposed (bubble / comm / recompute / tiling), bucket-size + TP-degree sweeps, and an honest 'what TorchTitan/Megatron do better' section. Log post #3.

title: Inference fundamentals — prefill vs decode, KV cache
task: Hand-rolled KV-cache generation loop on a small Llama; prove decode is memory-bound, then show how batch size, GQA, and quant move the roofline.

Inside vLLM: Anatomy of a High-Throughput Inference System

title: Build: paged KV cache (PagedAttention)
task: Paged KV cache by hand — allocator, block table, free list, COW for shared prefixes (your CS162 paging maps 1:1); measure fragmentation recovered.

title: Build: continuous-batching scheduler (Orca)
task: Iteration-level admit/preempt scheduler on the paged cache; stress it past KV-cache capacity — when to preempt vs queue, and how to avoid preemption thrash.

title: Build: radix-tree prefix cache (RadixAttention)
task: Radix-tree prefix cache; benchmark a shared-prefix (few-shot) workload and show the hit-rate / throughput gain, tree on vs off.

title: Build: OpenAI-compatible server + CUDA graphs
task: FastAPI OpenAI-compatible server (reuse your Prometheus/Grafana/Locust stack); add CUDA graphs for decode to kill launch overhead (the D1 launch-bound thread) and measure the win; stand up a ShareGPT harness.

links.label: NVIDIA — Getting Started with CUDA Graphs

title: Benchmark vs vLLM — per-feature attribution
task: Benchmark vs vLLM (throughput/TTFT/TPOT) under load; ablate each feature's contribution and give a mechanistic, profile-backed reason for every gap. This attribution is the strongest interview asset here.

title: Quantization — weight-only W4A16 (GPTQ/AWQ)
task: AWQ/GPTQ a model (reference repos); integrate W4A16 into your linears and prove the matmul is memory-bound so quant actually buys bandwidth (not a slow dequant path).

title: Build: speculative decoding (correct rejection sampling)
task: Draft-model speculative decoding with the exact modified rejection-sampling rule (Leviathan §3.1); measure acceptance rate + end-to-end speedup and prove the output distribution is preserved. The one deep optional — do it right.

links.label: GPU MODE Lecture 22 — Speculative Decoding in vLLM

links.label: GPU MODE Lecture 34 — Low-Bit Triton Kernels
NVIDIA Dynamo — KV-aware routing in production

title: Ship: nano-inference-engine (flagship)
task: Finalize the flagship: paged attn + continuous batching + prefix cache + CUDA graphs + W4A16 + spec decoding, with a design doc, diagrams, vLLM benchmarks, and the honest gap analysis up top. Log post #4.

title: ML compiler landscape — torch.compile internals
task: Trace the full Dynamo → Inductor → Triton path on your models; note where the compiler beats hand kernels and where it doesn't. (You already diffed torch.compile vs your FA kernel on D13.)

task: Implement the fix/feature/kernel; add tests; benchmark if it's a perf change.

title: Study: reproduce + ablate FA2's speedup curve
task: Research-style study (the DeepMind RE signal): reproduce FA2's forward speedup curve, ablate one design choice (block size / online-softmax vs two-pass), and report how the curve moves vs the paper. The deliverable is the finding.

title: Build: stretch — multi-host shard_map scaling
task: If TRC came through: run shard_map across a v3-8's cores; show a throughput curve + the ICI collective in the trace. Almost no new-grad applicant has touched real TPU topology.

title: Ship: JAX/TPU track + writeup
task: Polish flash-attention-pallas + the shard_map repo with TPU benchmark numbers; write the JAX-vs-PyTorch-distributed contrast post. Log post #6.

task: Study the co-design variables: FP8 E4M3 vs E5M2 range, MXFP4/6 block scaling, accumulator width, stochastic vs RNE rounding, error accumulation in a K-deep reduction.

task: MXFP4 (and/or FP8 E4M3) matmul from scratch — block scaling, quant/dequant path, explicit accumulator precision — as a Triton kernel so it runs and benchmarks. The MatX/Etched bullseye.

title: Build: numerics co-design study
task: Plot output error vs format (FP32/BF16 accumulation, block size, SR vs RNE, E4M3 vs E5M2) on a real weight/activation distribution; write the accumulator-width + per-block-scaling co-design conclusion.

title: tt-metal — the Metalium kernel model
task: Work the tt-metal programming examples on the Metalium simulator (no hardware needed) — circular buffers, explicit NoC data movement, tile-based math.

title: Build: a tt-metal compute kernel

title: Build: CuTe / CUTLASS tiled GEMM
task: CuTe tiled GEMM with explicit TiledMMA / TiledCopy; benchmark vs your Triton matmul. The on-GPU proxy for the tile / data-movement-explicit thinking chip stacks force.

title: Ship: chip / numerics track + writeup
task: Polish low-precision-gemm + tt-metal-kernel + cute-gemm; write the 'SIMT vs dataflow vs systolic, in practice' post — far stronger than a literature survey. Log post #7.

title: Capstone: nanochat end-to-end
task: Run the full nanochat pipeline on 8×H100. Mandatory stretch (not optional): drop in your Triton FA kernel or quantize inference with your engine, and measure the end-to-end delta — this proves the summer compounded.
